newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Nepline given 6-yr oil contract by Esso.
newsitem.headline: Nepline given 6-yr oil contract by Esso.

text.p: Malaysian shipping firm Nepline Bhd said on Wedensday it had secured a contract to transport crude oil within Malaysia for six years from Esso Malaysia Bhd.
The contract with Esso is a "Contract of Affreightment" for three years with an option of renewal for another three years to transport crude oil within Malaysia, said Nepline.
Nepline said the contract would generate a freight turnover of around 25 million ringgit per annum, and is the largest one obtained by the company from any of the local oil companies.
The company also said it was "considering venturing into chemical and vegetable oil trade in view of the very promising outlook of these two trades, particularly in the Asia-Pacific region".
